title: Another cyclone likely to hit Andhra coast on Nov 2 - Rediff

full_text:
The meteorological department has issued a weather alert as a well-marked low-pressure area in the Bay of Bengal is set to intensify into a depression near the Andhra Pradesh coast by November 2, bringing potential weather disruptions.
Key Points
- A low-pressure area over the South Andaman Sea has become a well-marked low-pressure area.
- This system is expected to intensify into a depression near the Andhra Pradesh coast by November 2.
- The weather system was located over the Southeast Bay of Bengal and adjoining areas at 5:30 am on Saturday.
- It is likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify further, reaching the west-central Bay of Bengal near the Andhra Pradesh coast around evening of November 2.
The low-pressure area over the South Andaman Sea, adjoining the North Andaman Sea and Andaman and Nicobar Islands, moved west to northwestwards to become a well-marked low-pressure area, which is expected to intensify into a depression near the Andhra Pradesh coast by November 2.
Bay Of Bengal Weather Update
The weather system lay over the Southeast Bay of Bengal and adjoining areas of Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Andaman Sea at 5:30 am on Saturday, an official press release from the meteorological separtment said.
According to the met department, the well-marked low-pressure area is likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify into a depression over the same region during the next 12 hours.
Thereafter, it is likely to intensify further and move west-northwestwards and reach over the west-central Bay of Bengal near the Andhra Pradesh coast around evening of November 2.
